purpose: Shared business semantic schema for policy extraction, connected knowledge and request assessment.

Customer.label: Customer
Customer.definition: A person or organization with a banking relationship.

Borrower.label: Borrower
Borrower.definition: A customer seeking or receiving credit; a specialized Customer.

LoanApplication.label: Loan application
LoanApplication.definition: A request for credit, distinct from an originated loan.

Loan.label: Loan
Loan.definition: An originated credit agreement or facility.

CreditPolicy.label: Credit policy
CreditPolicy.definition: A stable policy identity across separately identified versions.

PolicyVersion.label: Policy version
PolicyVersion.definition: An immutable, source-bound version of a credit policy.

PolicySection.label: Policy section
PolicySection.definition: A section of one policy version, optionally nested within another section.

PolicyRule.label: Policy rule
PolicyRule.definition: A source-derived normative requirement within exactly one policy version.

requirement_text.description: Exact operative source statement, including qualitative duties.

Condition.label: Condition
Condition.definition: A typed comparison used in scope, eligibility or exception logic.

ConditionGroup.label: Condition group
ConditionGroup.definition: An explicit AND, OR or NOT expression over conditions or nested groups.

Threshold.label: Threshold
Threshold.definition: A numerical boundary with an operator and unit, measured against exactly one metric.

CustomerSegment.label: Customer segment
CustomerSegment.definition: A controlled grouping of customers, such as SME; no numerical SME definition is assumed.

Product.label: Product
Product.definition: A controlled credit product or facility type.

Geography.label: Geography
Geography.definition: A jurisdiction or geographic grouping used in explicit policy scope.

RiskMetric.label: Risk metric
RiskMetric.definition: A defined quantitative measure with declared permitted units and optional formula.

Exception.label: Exception
Exception.definition: A conditional deviation from one base rule. Approval and alternative rules are explicit links.

ApprovalRequirement.label: Approval requirement
ApprovalRequirement.definition: A required decision by an identified authority; this is not an approval already granted.

ApprovalAuthority.label: Approval authority
ApprovalAuthority.definition: An accountable role or committee empowered to make a specified decision.

EvidenceRequirement.label: Evidence requirement
EvidenceRequirement.definition: A required evidence type and optional freshness condition.

ControlEvidence.label: Control evidence
ControlEvidence.definition: An actual evidence artifact with its recorded verification state.

EffectivePeriod.label: Effective period
EffectivePeriod.definition: An inclusive start date and optional inclusive end date; absent period means unknown validity.

SourcePassage.label: Source passage
SourcePassage.definition: Exact evidence text, source identity, version and checksum; never a generated policy summary.

TaxonomyConcept.label: Taxonomy concept
TaxonomyConcept.definition: A reference to a controlled classification concept; classification is distinct from executable applicability.

DataAttribute.label: Data attribute
DataAttribute.definition: An exact source-system or workbook attribute; bindings require separate governance.

HAS_APPLICABILITY.label: has applicability
HAS_APPLICABILITY.definition: Source-backed scope inherited by rules of this policy version.

HAS_EXCLUSION.label: has exclusion
HAS_EXCLUSION.definition: Source-backed exclusion from a policy version.

APPLIES_FOR.label: applies for
APPLIES_FOR.definition: A borrower submits a credit application.

REQUESTS_PRODUCT.label: requests product
REQUESTS_PRODUCT.definition: The product requested by an application.

RESULTS_IN.label: results in
RESULTS_IN.definition: An application results in an originated loan; absence does not imply rejection.

BORROWS.label: borrows
BORROWS.definition: A borrower is a party to an originated loan.

OF_PRODUCT.label: of product
OF_PRODUCT.definition: The product type of an originated loan.

GOVERNED_BY.label: governed by
GOVERNED_BY.definition: The exact policy version governing a loan; not inferred merely from product mentions.

VERSION_OF.label: version of
VERSION_OF.definition: A policy version belongs to one stable policy identity.

PART_OF_VERSION.label: part of version
PART_OF_VERSION.definition: A section or rule belongs to exactly one policy version.

PARENT_SECTION.label: parent section
PARENT_SECTION.definition: Optional containing section within the same version.

CONTAINS_RULE.label: contains rule
CONTAINS_RULE.definition: A policy version or section contains a rule.

APPLIES_TO_PRODUCT.label: applies to product
APPLIES_TO_PRODUCT.definition: Explicit applicability to a product, distinct from classification.

APPLIES_TO_SEGMENT.label: applies to segment
APPLIES_TO_SEGMENT.definition: Explicit applicability to a customer segment.

APPLIES_IN.label: applies in
APPLIES_IN.definition: Explicit geographic scope of a rule.

MEMBER_OF_SEGMENT.label: member of segment
MEMBER_OF_SEGMENT.definition: Source-backed customer membership in a segment.

USES_METRIC.label: uses metric
USES_METRIC.definition: A rule uses a defined risk measure.

HAS_THRESHOLD.label: has threshold
HAS_THRESHOLD.definition: A rule has a numerical boundary.

MEASURED_BY.label: measured by
MEASURED_BY.definition: The metric against which a threshold is interpreted.

HAS_CONDITION.label: has condition
HAS_CONDITION.definition: The explicit logical condition for a rule, exception or approval requirement.

HAS_MEMBER.label: has member
HAS_MEMBER.definition: A logical expression contains comparison terms or nested expressions.

HAS_EXCEPTION.label: has exception
HAS_EXCEPTION.definition: A rule permits an explicitly stated exception.

EXCEPTION_TO.label: exception to
EXCEPTION_TO.definition: The one base rule from which an exception permits deviation.

IMPLEMENTED_BY_RULE.label: implemented by rule
IMPLEMENTED_BY_RULE.definition: An optional alternative rule specifies the permitted deviation.

REQUIRES_APPROVAL.label: requires approval
REQUIRES_APPROVAL.definition: A rule or exception requires a decision, not evidence that it has been granted.

REQUIRES_APPROVAL_FROM.label: requires approval from
REQUIRES_APPROVAL_FROM.definition: The role or committee required for an approval decision.

REQUIRES_EVIDENCE.label: requires evidence
REQUIRES_EVIDENCE.definition: A rule or approval requires an evidence type.

SATISFIES_REQUIREMENT.label: satisfies requirement
SATISFIES_REQUIREMENT.definition: A recorded claim that an evidence artifact satisfies a requirement; verification remains explicit.

EVIDENCE_FOR.label: evidence for
EVIDENCE_FOR.definition: An evidence artifact supports an application, rule or exception.

HAS_EFFECTIVE_PERIOD.label: has effective period
HAS_EFFECTIVE_PERIOD.definition: An explicitly stated validity period; no period implies no known validity.

DERIVED_FROM.label: derived from
DERIVED_FROM.definition: A rule is grounded in one or more exact source passages from its own policy version.

SOURCE_IN_VERSION.label: source in version
SOURCE_IN_VERSION.definition: The policy version containing an exact source passage.

CLASSIFIED_AS.label: classified as
CLASSIFIED_AS.definition: A semantic entity is classified using an external controlled taxonomy.

BINDS_TO_ATTRIBUTE.label: binds to attribute
BINDS_TO_ATTRIBUTE.definition: An explicit proposed or reviewed metric-to-data binding; never inferred from similar labels.

semantic_constraints.definition: Node and relationship IDs must be unique across the instance.
Every relationship endpoint exists and satisfies the declared domain/range, including subclass inheritance.
Every assertion and every non-passage entity has exact SourcePassage references.
A rule and its derived source passages belong to the same policy version; source checksum/version agree.
Section/rule containment and parent-section links agree with PART_OF_VERSION.
Each threshold has one metric; its unit is permitted by that metric and the owning rule USES_METRIC.
A QUANTITATIVE rule has at least one threshold and metric.
HAS_EXCEPTION and EXCEPTION_TO agree; an implemented alternative has rule_kind EXCEPTION_RULE and shares the base version.
IN/NOT_IN use nonempty lists; EXISTS omits value; other comparisons require scalar values; ordered comparisons require numbers.
NOT has exactly one member; AND/OR have at least one; condition groups and section parents are acyclic.
An end date, when provided, cannot precede the start date.
EXAMPLE instances are synthetic and use illustrative passages; SOURCE_BACKED instances cannot cite illustrative passages.
An entity supported by synthetic source passages must itself retain the synthetic flag.

taxonomic_integration: CLASSIFIED_AS references taxonomy IDs and version; it never establishes applicability.
operational_integration: Source-backed policy versions, rules, scope and evidence populate the graph used by policy views and compliance matching.
approval_semantics: Schema conformance checks structure and consistency; it does not verify source interpretation or grant business approval.
